info.title: nd API
info.description: Peer-to-peer home EV charger sharing. Authentication routes under /auth/* are served by Better Auth and are not listed here. Errors are application/problem+json.

post.description: Schedules the account for deletion in 7 days and signs it out on every device at once. Until then it cannot be signed in to; the emailed link undoes the request (POST /me/delete/cancel). After that, personal data is removed; past bookings and payments are kept without it, for accounting. Refused (409, with reasons) while a booking is not finished or a payment is still owed.

Keeps an account scheduled for deletion, using the token from the link in the deletion email. Works until the deletion falls due; then sign in again as usual. Needs no session: the deletion request signed every device out.

token.description: The token from the undo link in the deletion email

get.summary: Search bookable chargers near a point for a window
get.description: Online chargers accepting bookings, with an availability window covering the whole slot and no booking overlapping it, nearest first. Positions are approximate.
Listing, host summary, rating and free slots for the next 7 days. The address and exact position are included only for a driver with a confirmed, arrived or active booking at this charger.

post.description: Creates the host profile (once) and a Stripe Express account for payouts, and returns a fresh link to Stripe's onboarding.

country.description: Country of the host's payouts account

post.description: Checks the charger can connect (Zappi v2.1, serial starting with 2, or Zappi GLO) and returns the OCPP URL, ChargeboxID and password to enter in the charger's account. The password is shown once and stored only as an argon2 hash. Asking again for a charger still connecting replaces its password.

location.description: Exact position; shown to drivers only once booked

get.summary: Wait for a charger to connect
get.description: Long-polls until the charger sends its first BootNotification, or `wait` seconds pass (capped by the server), then returns its state. Poll again while `connected` is false.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Seconds to wait for the charger to connect (capped by the server)

patch.summary: Set a charger's price, availability and listing
patch.description: Changes only the fields sent. `availability` replaces every window; price, kWh cap and instant book apply to every window. Publishing (`acceptingBookings: true`) needs the charger online on firmware 5.794 or later, payouts enabled and at least one window, otherwise 409 lists what is missing.

post.summary: Register a device for push notifications
post.description: iOS and Android send their FCM registration token; the web app sends its push subscription. A token already registered (by this account or another signed in on the same device) is moved to the caller and refreshed: 201 when new, 200 when known. Each account keeps its 10 most recently seen devices.

token.description: The FCM registration token (iOS devices register through FCM too)

subscription.description: The browser's PushSubscription, as `subscription.toJSON()` gives it

delete.summary: Stop push notifications to a device
delete.description: Call on sign-out. Another account's device is 404.

get.description: Every switch is on until the user turns it off.

patch.description: Changes only the switches sent; answers all of them.

post.description: Books a charger for a slot inside one of its availability windows. With instant book the booking is confirmed at once; otherwise it waits for the host. The quote is the slot's minutes at the hourly price, with no fee added. A slot starting within 6 days is authorised on the card now (manual capture); a later one keeps the saved card and is authorised 24 hours before the start. An overlapping slot is 409 and nothing is charged; a declined card is 402.

from.description: Start of the slot, on a whole minute

to.description: End of the slot (exclusive), on a whole minute

vehiclePlate.description: Number plate of the car being charged; shown to the host

paymentMethodId.description: A saved card; the default card when omitted

get.description: Latest slot first; filter by status and by a window the slot overlaps.
For its driver or the host of its charger; anyone else gets 404. The driver sees the address and exact position only while the booking is confirmed, arrived or active.

post.description: The host of the charger confirms a requested booking; its idTag is issued. 409 if the slot has been taken since.
The host turns a request down; the card authorisation is released.

The driver or the host cancels a requested or confirmed booking. A driver cancelling a confirmed booking after the host's cutoff (default 2 hours before the start) pays one hour at the hourly price, capped at the quote; otherwise the authorisation is released. Once the driver has arrived a booking can only be stopped (409).

The driver says they have arrived, from 15 minutes before the slot starts until it ends: a confirmed booking becomes arrived and the window-end stop is scheduled. A position (lat and lng), when sent, is compared with the charger's; the distance is recorded but never refused. Checking in again changes nothing.

distanceM.description: How far from the charger the position given on arrival was, in metres

nearCharger.description: Within 300 m of the charger; recorded, never enforced

post.description: The driver of an arrived booking starts charging: the charger is sent a remote start with the booking's idTag. The answer is the session: `starting` until the charger reports StartTransaction (then `charging`, pushed as `session:update`), or `failed` with a reason and copy to show, after which starting again retries. A charger that refuses because a stale transaction is open is soft-reset and the start retried once. With `startAt` in the future the session is `scheduled` and the remote start is sent then. Starting while a start is pending or a session runs returns it unchanged.

startAt.description: Start charging later, inside the slot (for a cheaper night rate). The driver plugs in now and pays from now.

post.description: The driver stops charging: a running session is sent a remote stop and stays `charging` until the charger reports StopTransaction, when it becomes `stopped` and the booking `completed`. A start not yet begun is abandoned and a scheduled start cancelled. Stopping again, or with nothing running, returns the session unchanged. 503 when the charger does not answer (unplugging the cable also stops it).

get.description: Status, energy, power, time and cost so far (rounded up to 5 minutes at the hourly price, capped at the quote) and when the charger last reported, for the booking's driver or host. The same shape is pushed over /ws as `session:update`.

post.description: Creates the driver's Stripe customer on first use and a SetupIntent for an off-session card. The first card saved becomes the default.

get.description: Brand, last four digits and expiry only.

post.description: The card bookings use when they do not name one.

get.description: The tax details platform reporting needs. The TIN is masked to its last three characters and the date of birth is never returned.

put.description: Stores the legal identity and tax identification number that EU (DAC7) and UK platform reporting need before a host's first payout, marks the host's tax details complete and releases transfers held only for them. The TIN is checked against its country's format (a PPSN with its check letter for Ireland; a 10-digit UTR or a National Insurance number for the UK). The TIN and date of birth are encrypted at rest. Replaces any earlier details.

tin.description: Tax identification number: a PPSN or tax reference for Ireland, a UTR or National Insurance number for the UK

companyNumber.description: Companies Registration Office number (IE) or Companies House number (UK)

tin.description: Tax identification number: a PPSN or tax reference for Ireland, a UTR or National Insurance number for the UK

get.description: For the driver or the host, once the session has stopped (409 before). Billing is by time: the minutes from session start to stop, rounded up to 5, at the hourly price and capped at the quote. Shows the energy delivered (meter start to stop), the effective price per kWh for comparison, the driver's card (driver only) and the host's payout (host only).

post.description: The driver rates a completed booking from 1 to 5, with an optional comment, once. The host's listing shows the average.

post.summary: Confirm a session closed without a stop
post.description: When the charger never reported the end of a session, it is closed from the last meter value and waits for the host. Confirming bills the driver now; otherwise they are billed 72 hours after it was closed. 409 unless the session is waiting for the caller's confirmation.

post.summary: Dispute a session closed without a stop
post.description: Instead of confirming, the host disputes the recorded session. Nothing is charged or paid out until support resolves it.

post.summary: Resolve a session that needs review
post.description: Support decides what the driver pays for a session in review (meter mismatch, missing stop, dispute): the amount is captured, open disputes on the booking are resolved, and the host's transfer is sent or held. Admins only (ADMIN_USER_IDS).

amountCents.description: What the driver pays; at most what was authorised. 0 releases the authorisation

post.description: Verified against the Stripe-Signature header and processed once per event id; a redelivered event is acknowledged without repeating its effects.
